title: PongLens
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a competitive player showing another player the thing they built. Unhurried and even, with the confidence to leave a word alone rather than push it. This is a first impression, not an instruction, so nothing is hurried and nothing is sold. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is a performance hub for competitive table tennis.
Get any match in from your phone, or straight from YouTube.
lines.label: Bring a match in

lines.text: It comes back as pure table tennis. The standing around is gone, and what is left is every point you played.
lines.label: Every point, cut out

lines.text: With playback built for studying the game.
lines.label: Built for studying

lines.text: Score the whole match in about ten minutes, just by saying who won each point.
lines.label: Ten minutes to score

lines.text: A scored match can finally answer real questions. Where your serve wins. How you hold up after nine all.
lines.label: What the match says

lines.text: Keep scoring, and the same picture builds across your season.
lines.label: Across your season

lines.text: Placement maps show what your opponent kept doing to you, and what kept working for you.
lines.label: Where the ball went

lines.text: And your coach can review the real match from anywhere. Drawings on the frame, voice notes on the exact point.
lines.label: You and your coach

lines.text: Lessons, notes, even pages from your notebook end up in one searchable journal.
lines.label: One journal

lines.text: Recollect brings the advice back right when you need it again.
lines.label: One journal

lines.text: When a rally deserves an audience, export it with the score on screen.
lines.label: Share the good ones

lines.text: PongLens. Film the match once. Learn from it all season.
